title: Strengthen golden-parity harness: TEXT dimension + swf-dump EdgeBounds/EditText id
description:
DONE (tools/ only; no packages/ or CLAUDE.md touched).

CHANGES:
1) tools/swf-dump/src/main.rs:
   - DefineShape: now also emits "edgeBounds" (shape.edge_bounds) alongside existing "bounds" (back-compat preserved; field added, none renamed).
   - DefineEditText: now emitted as a structured object with id + bounds, plus fontId/height/color when present (was previously a raw Debug fallback string with no id, so the harness saw charType '?'). Uses guarded accessors (Option) so absent optionals are omitted.
   - DefineText/DefineText2: now structured: id, bounds, matrix, and records[] with fontId, color, xOffset, yOffset, height, and glyphs[]{index,advance}.
   - Added text_record_to_json helper. cargo build succeeds.

2) tools/golden-parity.mjs:
   - New TEXT PARITY dimension: matches DefineText runs ours<->golden by their glyph-INDEX sequence (font-independent), then compares x_offset/y_offset/height/glyph-count = HARD DIFF; per-glyph advance deltas = KNOWN-GAP (NotoSans<->Arial font substitution).
   - SHAPE GEOMETRY now also compares edgeBounds (PASS if equal, counted as hard DIFF if not). Pre-existing fill-count gap still KNOWN-GAP.
   - Scorecard format, exit-code policy (exit 0 iff no HARD DIFF), and KNOWN-GAP ledger preserved. Added a NOTE explaining the expected-DIFF acceptance signal.

ACCEPTANCE (current tree, EXPECTED non-zero exit — proves harness now catches task 1193):
  TEXT PARITY  DIFF  text(id#7) rec0: x_offset 0!=3640 (title centering, task 1193); y_offset 720!=660; text(id#9) rec0: x_offset 0!=280; y_offset 360!=320  [+2 advance gap(s)]
  RESULT: 1 semantic dimension(s) FAIL
Other dimensions unchanged: PLACEMENTS PASS (4/4), SHAPE GEOMETRY KNOWN-GAP (fill expansion), HEADER/TAG INVENTORY/SELF-DETERMINISM PASS. Verified on both golden and golden-v2. Will go green once the separate text-positioning fix lands.
